old_paragraph: - As soon as you have read the code that produces the wrong behaviour, make your edit in the very next call. Do not run more searches or re-read the same region to confirm first; verification comes after the edit.
new_paragraph: - You have just read code that you believe conflicts with the issue. State the conflicting operation and smallest justified correction, then edit next. If uncertain between two specific hypotheses, run at most one command whose output would differ between them (the issue reproduction or a targeted test), then decide from that observation. Do not repeat an unchanged check.
